name: lab-pwa-shell
description: Lab 006: a private app on the phone, with passkey sign-in and approvals, built on Plain Function's capabilities.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute pwa-shell --local --config wrangler.toml --file capabilities/core/schema.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute pwa-shell --remote --config wrangler.toml --file capabilities/core/schema.sql
scripts.off: wrangler kv key put off-switch on --binding KV --config wrangler.toml
scripts.on: wrangler kv key delete off-switch --binding KV --config wrangler.toml
